svg.title: LAMPE system component interactions
svg.desc: English overview of data source, data stream, ETL, scoring, backend and frontend interactions in LAMPE.

text.tspan: Solid arrows: runtime data and request flow • Dashed arrows: configuration or framework association • Thick arrows: orchestrated execution
